title: Count a hidden ternary local-ring cubic with high-rank quotient noise
statement: For n=3ed,d>=3, a translated ordinary ternary cubic with unit XYZ coefficient plus arbitrary binary quotient quadratic at3h<=e+1 has exact raw-ANF counting time O(Ln^2+n^8)+softO(d^19), space O(L+n^4)+softO(d^12).

requires: Actual rank-three chain family with e>=1,d>=3 and unit XYZ coefficient, and the primitive trace
Exact acquired representation and legal quotient support
provides: For n=3ed,d>=3, a translated ordinary ternary cubic with unit XYZ coefficient plus arbitrary binary quotient quadratic at3h<=e+1 has exact raw-ANF counting time O(Ln^2+n^8)+softO(d^19), space O(L+n^4)+softO(d^12).
assumptions: No residue smoothness/factorization or small quadratic rank is assumed
Raw fitter completeness d>=3; the coefficient-level backend may have a wider small-field scope
costs: Weighted singular rays, Hensel/origin descent, exact Gaussian sums and all reconstruction
A depth-one field terminal uses a published four-variable point count; its generic engine is not implemented here
contract.units: Original independent Boolean bits; F_(2^d) elements and ordinary field/ring exponents are distinct from Boolean ANF masks. Exact signed/zero counts and source-local phase/rank/depth units.
contract.obstruction: Do not apply the unweighted socle cancellation to a quotient-weighted ray, or extrapolate beyond the height gate.

body: A weighted radial character is evaluated as two binary Gaussian sums. Origin descent sends(e,h) to(e-3,max(h-1,0)), preserving3h<=e+1. Depths0/2 modulo3 need no field leaf. The archive preserves an e=3,height2 counterexample to the invalid local weight extraction.
